title: Compound V3 market position
description: Scoped supply, withdrawal and optional base borrowing in one named Comet market. Capital is a quantity of the named market's asset; the health factor is a protocol ratio. Grants carry no amount bound; repaying the fund's own debt needs no amount.

capital.description: Optional amount of the market asset the allocation starts with. The funding statement requires it before the first entry. It is not a limit: how much to supply is the strategy's decision. Defaults to zero.

borrow.description: Grant borrowing and repayment of this market asset. Supply and withdrawal are always granted; how much to borrow is the strategy's decision. Only the Comet base asset borrows; a collateral reserve refuses it. Defaults to false.

minimum_health_factor.description: Minimum projected health factor for an action that adds risk. Required when borrow is true; every allocation sharing that fund and market then states the same value. Omit it on an allocation that cannot borrow in a scope where none borrows (lend- or supply-only): there is no debt for it to bound, and while the fund carries any debt in that market an action the connector risk-checks is refused.
